text: Over the last 30 days, some visitors have raised concerns about overcrowding, especially during school group visits, which limited access to exhibits. Several critical reviews focused on the heavy use of AI in the exhibits, with some feeling it detracted from the educational value and historical substance. A few visitors noted a lack of detailed historical interpretation and context about Theodore Roosevelt’s accomplishments. Positive comments frequently mentioned the interactive exhibits and the building’s architecture, but issues with accessibility and exhibit design were also noted. Addressing these concerns could improve the overall visitor experience.

windows.60: Over the past 60 days, visitors have noted significant crowding issues, especially during school group visits, which limited access to many exhibits. Several reviews criticized the heavy reliance on AI-driven interactive elements, describing them as lacking educational depth and not aligned with Theodore Roosevelt’s legacy. Some visitors also found the AI kiosks physically uncomfortable to use. While many appreciated the architecture and interactive exhibits overall, there were repeated comments about insufficient historical interpretation and a desire for more substantive content. Parking and timed entry procedures were also mentioned as areas needing attention.
